page_topic_one_liner: Generative AI landscape map — companies, verticals, agents, enterprise adoption, and funding trends from VC, consulting, and research sources
differentiator_vs_generic: This is a curated industry landscape map for competitive research, NOT a generic AI stock image or chatbot screenshot. Hero must be a multi-layer market map with vertical swim lanes, company logo blur nodes, and agent/enterprise tier bands.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Multi-layer AI landscape map — horizontal swim lanes for verticals (text, image, video, code, enterprise) with blurred company logo nodes placed in lanes and connecting dotted lines
Agent tier band across bottom — autonomous agent, copilot, workflow automation as three connected blocks with accent border
Secondary: funding heat strip — VC/consulting/research source icons with blurred bar heights indicating activity level
anti_patterns: Generic robot or brain stock photo
Single LLM chat panel as hero
Unstructured logo cloud without lane taxonomy

en.headline: GENERATIVE AI LANDSCAPE
en.subtitle: Companies · Verticals · Enterprise
en.composition: Visual-only editorial collage for generative AI industry landscape insights. HERO: multi-layer market map on right two-thirds — horizontal swim lanes (text, image, video, code, enterprise) with blurred generic company logo nodes and dotted interconnections. Secondary: agent tier band at bottom (autonomous agent / copilot / workflow) with klein-blue accent border on agent block. Tertiary: funding heat strip with VC, consulting, research source icons and blurred activity bars. Title top-left. Paper torn edges, halftone. NO robot stock photo, NO chat UI hero, NO real company logos, NO blank cards.
